claim_levels.L0_ALGORITHM_COMPONENTS: Unit-tested RAO equations, schemas, and batch compilation
claim_levels.L1_SYNTHETIC_FLYWHEEL: Model-in-the-loop synthetic multi-round training and resume
claim_levels.L2_DEEPDIVE_SHORT_RUN: Real DeepDive tools, judge, and at least one optimizer step
claim_levels.L3_FAITHFUL_75_STEPS: Faithful DeepDive configuration for at least 75 optimizer steps
claim_levels.L4_PAPER_EFFECT: Controlled baselines, ablations, uncertainty, and comparable effect

gates.acceptance: Equation-level tests pass and a captured batch can be recomputed independently.
Two rounds publish different adapter hashes and resume reloads the prior checkpoint.
Dataset hash matches the baseline and a fixed 50-task split manifest is used by train and evaluation.
DeepDive rollout executes Python REPL actions with async launch_subagent and preserves exact action-token logprobs.
A faithful 16 x 8 tree batch completes collection, judging, compilation, one optimizer step, and publication.
Pinned providers support retry, rate limiting, caching, strict schemas, missing-signal quarantine, and cost/failure metrics.

evidence: recursive_agent_training/optimizers/areal_optimizer.py is a thin optimizer factory wrapper
gates.acceptance: Eight-GPU distributed rollout and optimization complete with versioning, staleness, checkpoint load, and snapshot publication.

evidence: 40K and 256K values are present in YAML only
gates.acceptance: 40K train and 256K evaluation execute with audited truncation and action-token/logprob preservation.
The fixed 50-task split produces per-task records, success, pass@8, bootstrap confidence intervals, and behavior metrics.
Base/single, trained/single, base/recursive, and trained/recursive are evaluated under identical controls.

evidence: Ablation YAML files exist but are not orchestrated
gates.acceptance: Dense/sparse and weighted/unweighted runs produce a common result table.
At least 75 optimizer steps, resumable checkpoints, curves, costs, failures, comparisons, and implementation differences are archived.
